en: Fixed a false "Couldn't save this change" warning after adding a permission rule or directory in a subfolder or worktree whose own `.claude/settings.local.json` is unreadable or malformed
zh: 修复了在子文件夹或 worktree 中添加权限规则或目录后，若其自身的 `.claude/settings.local.json` 不可读或格式错误，会出现错误的“Couldn't save this change”警告的问题
